action_summary: Builds the corpus the last round said did not exist, and runs the unchanged engine on it. Mining is blind to outcome: 15,115 real commits across 15 projects, one source file + one test file + exactly one changed line -> 181 candidates; admission is the project's own pytest verdict (the commit's test fails on the parent, passes at the commit, nothing that passed goes red) -> 45 tasks, 26 of them expression replacements. Two instrument defects were found by the miner's own tests before any receipt: the gate was placing the parent's test on the parent (75 of 181 'not checkable', actually 24) and mode='eval' was reading changed lines instead of the expression payload (163 of 181 misclassified, actually 80 expression pairs). The engine then ran on 89 machine-gated fixes and 45 unseen ones: 68 rows reached the demand reader, 25 bound a demand, 1 was verified, and that one is the attrs message row the engine had already been tuned on. 0 of 45 unseen.

obs_solution.efficiency_mechanism: Ordering and exact fit replace breadth: 409 flips decided 15 commits, and no candidate refinement was scored, ranked or thresholded.
obs_solution.generality_mechanism: The rewrite is generic Python AST plus a counter; the oracle is the project's own pytest; the address is a site and a firing, so it carries to any executable artifact.
obs_solution.losing_routes_reason: Message channel: 1 of 15 at the line, 0 at the expression. Whole-predicate flips: cannot express a guard that is right once and wrong once. Scoring: unnecessary once fit is exact. Stored state: costlier than re-measuring in ~50 microseconds.

truth.statement: Verification is free and exact, memory is free, localisation and adaptation are measured; the content of a repair is authored and appears nowhere in the environment. On 134 real fixes the demand-driven engine derives and verifies one, and that one it had already solved.

that the bottleneck is learning speed: it is content
that the 1-of-30 result was an artefact of a small corpus: with power it is 1 of 134

a pin as permanent, parameter-free knowledge that passes at fixed and fails at reverted
